name: Echo CS-310
blurb: A 30.5 cc homeowner saw: 14″ and 16″ bars on 3/8″ low-profile chain, .050″ gauge, 52–57 drive links per Echo's own chart.
intro: The Echo CS-310 is a 30.5 cc homeowner saw. Echo lists 14″ and 16″ bars for the CS-310, both on 3/8″ low-profile .050″ chain.

bars.note: Echo bar 14A0CD3752C; chain 91PX52CQ. Non-replaceable-nose laminated bar per the chart.
Echo bar 16A0CD3757C; chain 91PX57CQ. The chart lists 16″ as the longest standard bar for this saw.

sources.title: ECHO chainsaws catalog (Jan 2023) — “Bars and Chains” chart: bar and chain part numbers, drive-link count, gauge, pitch and file size per saw; saw specification tables
